items.claim: CEO 表示公司提出新的 2028 財年每股盈餘能力目標 $40。
items.quote: in 2028, we figured that we can now deliver $40 of earnings power
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱最大客戶自上次財報後大幅增加 OCS 訂單。
items.quote: huge uptick in our order book and the order rate
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 認為先前公布的 OCS 80 億美元 TAM 被低估。
items.quote: the TAM now looks like it's significantly undercalled
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 承認目前 OCS 主要綁定單一客戶。
items.quote: we're predominantly today, I'd say, tied to one customer
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 CPO 與 NPO 對光學產業是加成而非互相取代。
items.quote: completely additive to the numbers that we see today
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 CPO／NPO 目前尚未反映在公司營收數字中。
items.quote: nothing is showing up in our number
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 scale across 業務毛利率高且成長快但較少人討論。
items.quote: Our scale across business is quite high margin.
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 說明 EML 由 100G 升到 200G 的價格倍數。
items.quote: you're seeing about a 2x uplift in price
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 200G EML 目前競爭少、近期也無新進者。
items.quote: We don't see a lot of competitive threats on the horizon either
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 預期 1.6T 時 EML 型收發器占比降至市場的 40%～50%（800G 約 70%～80%），絕對數量仍增加。
items.quote: 40% to 50% of the market at 1.6T
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱目前未見中國雷射供給造成影響。
items.quote: we see no impact from any Chinese laser supply
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 認為中國雷射業者趕上所需時間比外界認為的長。
items.quote: I think it's going to take longer than people think.
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 NPO 機會近期比 CPO 更大。
items.quote: actually larger than the CPO opportunity, at least in the near term
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 說明 Greensboro 晶圓廠於 2026 初收購、2028 初才投產。
items.quote: it's not operational until early calendar 2028
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 表示新增產能投資前需看到類似 NVIDIA 的客戶承諾。
items.quote: I would definitely need to see a similar type of commitment
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 NPO 放量時點由原先預期的 2028 底／2029 初提前。
items.quote: it's a late 2027 into early 2028 event
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 NPO 需求將對 Greensboro 晶圓廠產能造成壓力。
items.quote: it's going to put a lot of pressure, a lot of pressure on that Greensboro fab
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱產能最大限制是時間（認證週期長）。
items.quote: the headline is just time
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱基板供給緊，已在日本供應商之外再與 AXT 簽約。
items.quote: we went out and did another deal with AXTI
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 說明在 NVIDIA 的產品認證耗時一年。
items.quote: it was a year cycle for us to get qualified at NVIDIA
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱系統（模組）業務單季營收規模。
items.quote: running well over $200 million a quarter in that business
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 承認模組業務毛利率尚未改善。
items.quote: We've yet to fix the gross margin.
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 承認模組毛利表現不及頂尖競爭者。
items.quote: We don't perform as well as the top competitors.
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱 2027 年起將著手改善製造以提升毛利。
items.quote: how do we fix the manufacturing?
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 回顧 Cloud Light 過去的品質問題。
items.quote: a lot of quality problems coming out of Cloud Light
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 不視異質整合為威脅。
items.quote: I don't see it as a threat
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 稱公司被視為美國禁中國收發器的淨受益者。
items.quote: We are viewed, probably correctly so as a net beneficiary
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 指出中國收發器廠商在美國市場的占比。
items.quote: make 70% of the transceivers in the U.S. market
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston

items.claim: CEO 指出未來 12～18 個月要觀察的重點是 scale-in（託盤內光互連）。
items.quote: that's the thing to watch over the next 12 to 18 months
items.speaker: CEO Michael Hurlston
